post.summary: Scan local filenames with the bound saved parser profile and atomically replace song metadata
post.description: Administrator/CSRF protected synchronous filename-only scan. LOCAL only; WebDAV returns 400 without remote requests. Includes nested directories without following symlinks. Limits: 2000 media files, 20000 visited entries, 32 directory levels, 30 seconds traversal/parse budget. Supported extensions: mkv, mp4, mpg, mpeg, avi, ts, vob, mov, wmv. Unmatched files remain as needs-review records. A completed scan replaces the source index and removes records for disappeared files; originals are never modified. Failure/limit/configuration change keeps prior index. Repeated filenames retain stable IDs. Profile changes apply on next scan. 60s browser request timeout; WebDAV uses the separate scan-tasks API. If a previously indexed source suddenly produces zero media files, returns 409 and preserves its index to guard against an empty disconnected mount.

post.summary: Queue a WebDAV filename-only scan
post.description: Administrator session required; writes require CSRF. WEBDAV sources only for creation. Uses Depth: 1 PROPFIND, never media GET/HEAD or redirects. Limits: 100000 media, 1000000 child entries, 128 directory levels, two hours; connect timeout 10s, each directory request 60s and 64 MiB. Two workers and 32 queued tasks; one active task per source. Full staged result is published atomically. Restart interrupts tasks; manually restart scanning. Task IDs are scoped to their source. Terminal tasks retained seven days with at least the latest per source. No credentials or response XML returned.

password.description: WebDAV only. Omitted/null retains the saved password only when URL and username are unchanged; empty string clears it. Stored encrypted; never returned.

FilenameRule.description: Ordered rule. BUILTIN requires builtinId and a null/omitted expression; custom rules require an expression and no builtinId. Templates and RE2 named groups require artist/title; optional code/language/version/quality/extra. All supplied rules, including disabled rules, are validated.

PreviewFilename.description: Omitted/null rules uses the saved configuration. An empty array explicitly disables all rules. Draft preview does not persist.

FilenameParseResult.description: Artist/title structure evidence, not verified musical identity. Auxiliary labels may remain on SUCCESS results. songCode preserves leading zeros.

FilenameParserWorkspace.description: Consistent shared snapshot. changedId identifies a created/updated/deleted entity; null on GET. Enablement/order belong to profile entries. GET projects legacy data without persistence.

fileSize.description: Null when the WebDAV directory response does not provide this property; no media file request is made.

modifiedAt.description: Null when the WebDAV directory response does not provide this property; no media file request is made.

metadata.description: Separate confirmed overlay. Ignore when stale; raw filename result remains unchanged.

MediaScanTask.description: Persisted background WebDAV filename scan. Counts report discovered work; no total or percentage is available while enumerating. Terminal errors are sanitized; old index remains on failure/cancellation/interruption.

minIntervalSeconds.description: Batch delay range in seconds after each song. Maximum must be >= minimum; omitted fields use defaults.

maxIntervalSeconds.description: Batch delay range in seconds after each song. Maximum must be >= minimum; omitted fields use defaults.

artistRefs.description: Optional platform artist identities from confirmed song metadata; older saved tracks default to an empty list.

sourceId.description: Optional media source ID when all is true; limits the batch to that source

confidence.description: Presentation guidance only. HIGH meets batch similarity threshold; LOW is >=.8 but below threshold; NONE is missing or <.8. Raw score and automatic rules unchanged.

coverAvailable.description: Current nonstale confirmed cover available; browser still handles proxy/image failure.

total.description: Overall songs considered, including skippedExisting; equals pending + processing + review + applied + failed + skippedExisting.

completed.description: Judged/processed songs, including skippedExisting; equals review + applied + failed + skippedExisting. Review does not mean metadata applied.

skippedExisting.description: Songs skipped at creation because valid confirmed metadata already exists; included in total and completed.

processableTotal.description: Songs that require platform processing in this batch; total minus skippedExisting.

legacySkipped.description: Historic skipped songs whose IDs were never recorded. Included in global counts but absent from searchable item rows; no fabricated backfill.

observedAt.description: Server observation time for this consistent transaction; not a fabricated item update timestamp.

ReviewApply.description: Manual edits override candidate values for selected fields only. Cover cannot be supplied via edits: use owned candidate or managed asset. Empty values preserve current values. fingerprint/version enforce optimistic concurrency. Identical requestId + payload replays receipt for seven days; changed payload with reused ID returns 409. Manual entry/upload works without enabling external providers.

coverPath.description: Same-origin administrator cover URL, absent when no uploaded cover

coverVersion.description: Content SHA-256; independent from tag revision

parent.description: Null for the filesystem root listing; empty string returns to that listing.

displayMode.description: AI 助手展示形态；其他功能忽略

petId.description: 稳定宠物形象 ID，可扩展目录

localRoot.description: Absolute media root; longest local prefix wins.

remoteRoot.description: Absolute media root; longest local prefix wins.

endpoint.description: HTTP(S) origin only. Public endpoints require HTTPS.

mappings.description: 仅兼容读取旧配置；新媒体任务不使用目录映射

endpoint.description: HTTP(S) origin only. Public endpoints require HTTPS.

token.description: 32–256 visible ASCII chars. Blank keeps saved credential only for unchanged origin. Never returned.

revision.description: Opaque effective display metadata revision, used to refresh artwork

durationMs.description: Last known actual total duration of the current playback attempt on the original song timeline; omitted until the TV reports a valid duration.

stateRevision.description: Monotonic persisted session revision, including playback events; clients discard lower revisions for the same session. Queue optimistic concurrency still uses revision.

managed.description: False for unbound exact-credit browsing groups, which are not verified artist identities

count.description: Distinct current library song count; may be absent from write responses

requestId.description: Required on create; stable across retries

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Actual decoder profiles for the reported level and size/frame-rate limits. For h264 use ffprobe names such as Constrained Baseline, Baseline, Main and High; MIME support alone does not establish these capabilities.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: Actual maximum decoder level paired with the reported profiles. H264 uses ffprobe integer units: 31=3.1, 41=4.1, 9=1b. Explicit H264 profile/level limits also constrain compatibility output dimensions, frame rate and bitrate.

quality.description: Auto honors reported client limits; an explicit quality applies its additional size/frame-rate/bitrate ceiling.

force.description: Force video encoding and AAC audio in a new HLS execution (H264 unless codec is explicitly selected). Preserves start and selected audio role, bypasses older offline versions; an exactly matching compatible service cache may still be reused.

start.description: Requested position in original media seconds. A matching full-song cache may return HLS with offset 0; seek locally to max(0, start - resource.offset).

codec.description: HEVC/AV1 require matching client capabilities and a sample-verified encoder

audioRole.description: Resolve shared role at negotiation time; generated accompaniment uses backingUrl with the original timeline.

offset.description: Actual resource origin on the original media timeline, in seconds. Full-song cached HLS has offset 0 even for a nonzero requested start. All playback modes seek locally to max(0, requested start - offset) and report currentTime + offset.

sampledPeakRssBytes.description: Observed child RSS peak; zero means not observed, not zero usage

cacheHit.description: True when this playback uses an existing completed cache stored by Java; false for newly generated data.

cacheId.description: Opaque identifier for a verified Java-owned persistent cache; each playback retains its own authorization and lease.

backingUrl.description: Authenticated independent accompaniment; retain initial negotiation value during HLS polling.

format.description: Uppercase indexed extension; not a decoder capability guarantee

budget.description: Daily activity counters and cooldown timestamps only. No daily song-count or byte quota; per-file bounds and access-group pacing/cooldowns still apply.

directory.description: Managed directory relative to WEBDAV_METADATA_PATH; never the original media directory.

attachments.description: Optional artwork pending retry; text metadata and sharing remain available.

result.description: Persisted tags, technical streams, field coverage, cover hash and embedded lyrics. Never contains WebDAV credentials or download URLs.

resultState.description: Analysis outcome (CONFIDENT or UNKNOWN), separate from task execution state. Empty for legacy results without an outcome.

reason.description: UNKNOWN analysis reason: NO_RELIABLE_VOCALS, AMBIGUOUS_VOCALS, BOTH_VOCAL_TRACKS, CONFLICTING_WINDOWS, CONFLICTING_LABELS, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, INVALID_EVIDENCE, INSUFFICIENT_DURATION or NOT_DUAL_AUDIO. FAST_MODEL_MISSING indicates optional fast classifier weights/runtime are not installed.

evidence.description: Optional bounded diagnostic evidence, including analysisVersion, vocalRatio pairs, votes, informativeWindows and up to five windows (start, seconds, tracks with level, activeFrames, totalFrames, vocalFrames). Ratios are not calibrated probabilities. Legacy unknown results may omit evidence. FAST uses method LABELS or PANNS_CNN6, optional vocalScores pairs, and initially three, at most six short windows. fast-vocal-v2 uses paired score differences and consensus, retaining decisionPolicy and thresholds. Scores are classification evidence, not calibrated accuracy.

fallbackReason.description: Empty unless CPU fallback occurred; ACCELERATOR_NOT_READY or ACCELERATOR_EXECUTION_FAILED. The backend field records actual execution.

AudioProcessingSelection.description: Selection captures one published audio catalog generation. Media fingerprints are rechecked as each chunk is persisted; changed or deleted media becomes a failed member.

prepared.description: Members persisted so far; advances in chunks of at most 200

selectionTotal.description: Number of members captured from the selected published filter snapshot

error.description: Preparation failure message; empty on success

coverAvailable.description: Confirmed, non-stale cover is available through the song cover endpoint.

detected.description: Physical device evidence, independent of model or runtime readiness.

cpuFallback.description: Shared automatic CPU fallback policy for audio inference and video transcoding.

fastClassifier.description: Optional scan classifier, independent of separation-device selection. CPU-only bounded inference; no accelerator selection or Demucs fallback. installed and ready are separate.

startupCheck.description: Background startup qualification of installed models only; valid environment-bound qualifications are reused. Playback has priority. No automatic downloads.

imagePath.description: Authenticated same-origin image path; no filesystem path.

banners.description: Array order is display order. TV omits disabled entries. PUT must include exactly current banner IDs; upload/remove are separate revision-checked operations.

maxBytes.description: Persistent Java-server song-cache budget in bytes. Initialized to 10 GiB unless configured otherwise. Active leases are protected; shrinking may remain over budget until they finish.

policy.description: HYBRID is the default mixed retention policy; MANUAL disables automatic eviction. Legacy LRU/LFU/TTL writes are accepted as deprecated aliases for HYBRID. Existing automatic policies migrate to HYBRID with a revision increment.

ttlHours.description: Legacy round-trip field, retained for four-field request compatibility; HYBRID and MANUAL ignore it.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision. A stale save returns 409.

highWatermarkPercent.description: Integer percentage of the cache budget triggering automatic HYBRID reclamation. Must exceed lowWatermarkPercent. Omission preserves the saved value.

lowWatermarkPercent.description: Integer target percentage after HYBRID reclamation, below highWatermarkPercent. Protected entries may prevent reaching this target without exhausting usable capacity. Omission preserves the saved value.

id.description: Opaque cache artifact identifier; never a filesystem path.

songId.description: Originating song identifier retained in the server cache index, when available.

title.description: Current effective song title, when the song still exists.

artist.description: Current effective artists separated by /, when the song still exists.

hits.description: Cache reuse or open count. Realtime HLS counts reuse sessions rather than individual segment reads; original-file entries count cache opens.

leased.description: True while an active playback lease or original-file reader/writer protects this entry from manual and automatic eviction.

target.description: Cache parameters. mode=ORIGINAL identifies an unmodified original-file block cache, including partial entries; other modes describe computed media. Media inputs and callback origins are omitted.

mode.description: ORIGINAL for the source file, or an existing transcoding mode.

sourceBytes.description: Total original-file size; present for mode=ORIGINAL.

cachedBytes.description: Optional original-file bytes durably cached in complete blocks. A partial original cache is not a complete song.

residueBytes.description: Optional disk bytes occupied by invalid or pending-cleanup files. Included in actual usageBytes, but excluded from valid bytes/cachedBytes and original-file completeness.

sourceBytes.description: Optional total original-file size in bytes.

complete.description: Optional original-file completeness flag. False means uncached byte ranges still require the authorized source.

pinned.description: Song-level pin applies to every existing and future cache variant. It never forces a download.

H.description: Playback heat adds 0.05 per effective attempt, caps at one, and decays with a 14-day half-life. Increasing effective times aggregate in O(1); late effective events recompute that song chronologically to preserve cap/decay ordering. Prefetch/cache opens never increase heat.

R.description: Recency decayed with a 7-day half-life from actual playing activity, including ADMIN previews.

F.description: min(1,ln(1+effective plays in the preceding 7x24 hours)/ln(21)). ADMIN previews are excluded.

priority.description: Retention priority including the decaying three-day soft retention bonus. Higher values are retained longer; hard protections take precedence.

lastPlayedAt.description: Latest actual playback activity; paused/buffering/lease and prefetch do not refresh it.

usageBytes.description: Current bytes used in the Java-owned song-cache directory, including complete caches and in-progress temporary downloads; excludes compute temporary outputs and separate offline compatibility versions.

entryCount.description: Count of indexed realtime HLS and partial or complete original-file cache entries in the Java server.

skipped.description: Protected entries skipped, including active playback/download, song pins and actual playback within the previous 24 hours.

network.description: Optional RFC1918 IPv4 /24–/32; loopback is allowed only as a single /32. Public, link-local and IPv6 subnet scans are rejected. Defaults to callback-origin LAN, known node addresses and local private NIC networks (up to three /24 networks).

port.description: Optional single port. Defaults to 18090 and 8090; saved node endpoints are also checked.

ComputeLanScan.description: At most 768 hosts, 32 concurrent requests, 500 ms per discovery request, 10 s total and 32 returned nodes. Fixed private IPs only; redirects are refused.

discoveryId.description: Opaque server discovery record, valid for two minutes; arbitrary endpoint input is not accepted.

revision.description: Current ComputeNodeSettings revision; checked before pairing and again when saving.

endpoint.description: Pinned numeric private IP HTTP(S) origin; no DNS resolution or redirects during pairing.

pairingAvailable.description: Node pairing is enabled and owner is empty or matches this Java identity.

ComputeLanDiscovery.description: Never includes owner IDs, internal tokens, public/private keys, signatures or challenges.

requestedBy.description: Song requester snapshot; does not identify the actual singer.

playedMs.description: Actual elapsed playback in milliseconds, excluding pauses/buffering and seek jumps.

effective.description: False for ADMIN previews. Otherwise true when playedMs >= 30000, or a completed song with duration 1..29999 ms has playedMs >= durationMs.

PlaybackHistoryRecord.description: One persisted playback attempt, with independent song and device snapshots. No client reporting or administrator write endpoint is included in this release.

playCount.description: All matching non-ADMIN playback attempts for this song.

completedCount.description: Matching non-ADMIN attempts whose terminal status is COMPLETED; this is not a measure of listened coverage.

PlaybackPopularSong.description: Statistics grouped by songId, excluding all ADMIN preview attempts. Display metadata comes from the latest matching non-ADMIN playback snapshot. Different song IDs and versions are not merged.

totalPlays.description: All matching attempts, including short, failed and interrupted attempts.

playedSongs.description: Distinct song IDs among effective non-ADMIN attempts.

playedMs.description: Sum of actual playback time across all matching attempts, including ineffective attempts.

resolvedSongTitle.description: Song title snapshot captured when marked RESOLVED; retained if the song is later removed.

resolvedSongArtists.description: Artist snapshot captured when marked RESOLVED.

MissingSongFeedback.description: Administrator-registered missing-song request. Original feedback is immutable; only handling state, note and resolved song association can be changed. No automatic download is triggered.

requestId.description: Stable UUID reused for retries; the same ID with different normalized original feedback returns 409.

title.description: Nonblank after trimming; control characters are rejected.

artist.description: May be empty; control characters are rejected.

versionLabel.description: May be empty; control characters are rejected.

description.description: May be empty; line breaks and tabs are allowed, other control characters are rejected.

submittedBy.description: May be empty; control characters are rejected.

revision.description: Expected current revision; stale updates return 409.

handlingNote.description: Line breaks and tabs are allowed, other control characters are rejected.

resolvedSongId.description: A currently available library song is required for RESOLVED. For other states omit or send null; the association and resolvedAt are cleared.

confirmRecent.description: DELETE-only explicit recent-play override after user confirmation; never bypasses pin or active download/playback.

targetReached.description: Whether the requested reclaim target was reached; false does not necessarily imply insufficient capacity.

spaceInsufficient.description: True when the effective hard cache/disk capacity remains insufficient after cleanup; separate from targetReached.

errors.description: Sanitized per-entry failures; no server paths or credentials.

startedAt.description: Original client attempt clock anchor as UTC epoch milliseconds. Capture once with the monotonic clock; preserve across create retries. May be at most 24 hours old or 5000ms in the future. Optional for older-client compatibility; omission uses server creation time.

writeToken.description: Server-issued per-attempt secret bound to this login session and client type; never persist or log it.

eventSeq.description: Initial sequence is -1; subsequent reports use strictly increasing nonnegative values.

startedAt.description: Accepted original attempt clock anchor, as UTC epoch milliseconds; preserve it for subsequent samples.

serverTime.description: Server UTC epoch milliseconds at creation response; may help calibrate a future clock anchor without rewriting already captured snapshots.

actualPlayedMs.description: Cumulative actual main-media playing wall-clock milliseconds; exclude pause, buffering, preparation and seeks.

elapsedMs.description: Monotonic elapsed wall-clock milliseconds since the original client startedAt anchor, including actual playback before registration completes. Counters cannot decrease; actual increments cannot exceed elapsed increments plus 1000ms; elapsed cannot exceed server time minus the anchor plus 5000ms.

durationMs.description: Optional original-song duration in milliseconds; omit when unknown.

occurredAt.description: UTC epoch milliseconds captured with this event, anchored to startedAt plus monotonic elapsedMs. Preserve the sampled value across queues/retries; never replace it with send/receive time. Must agree with startedAt+elapsedMs within 5000ms and not exceed server time by more than 5000ms. Lease expires at the event occurrence time plus 120 seconds.

lastActivityAt.description: UTC epoch milliseconds of the last actual main-media playing activity in this snapshot, or null before playback starts. Advance only on actual playing time or a real resume; freeze during pause/buffering and across queued sends/retries. Recency and 24-hour protection use this occurrence time, not receipt time. Cannot exceed occurredAt (5000ms clock tolerance).

effective.description: Always false for ADMIN previews; MOBILE effective attempts require >=30 seconds actual playback or complete playback of a shorter song. Counted once per attempt.
